artifacts.summary: 6-phase, 8.5-hour plan for the Lean Sentence-to-Formula elimination, its truth-preservation theorem sat_iff, and a committed JSON fixture channel plus translate_sentence lean_exe for mechanical consumer cross-check.

memory_candidates.content: In the BimodalLogic (ProofChecker) repository, adding a new top-level directory under FormalSystem/ is not just a matter of writing .lean files: four independent mechanical gates must be updated in the same change or the build fails in ways whose error messages do not name each other. (1) scripts/measure-refactor-partitions.py's LANGUAGE_FILE_LAYERS needs a per-file row for a language directory (layer 0 = syntax, must import nothing from FormalSystem/Semantics/; layer 1 = semantics); without a row layer_of raises UnlayeredModuleError and check-metalogic-cycles.sh fails, and a stale row for a deleted file fails its assertion B. (2) ORGANISATION.md's layer table needs the matching row. (3) The root FormalSystem.lean must be regenerated with 'lake exe mk_all --lib FormalSystem' because check-module-invariants.sh C33 byte-compares it against the generator's output -- hand-editing it fails. (4) readme-lint.sh gates a README.md in every directory containing .lean files. Two further constraints shape file placement rather than registration: the # -command linter is disabled only for the BimodalTest/BimodalToolsTest libraries, so #guard fixture rows cannot live under FormalSystem/; and C25N forces a new lean_exe named 'foo_bar' to have root module PascalCase = FooBarMain.
